lines.text: A one percent fee sounds tiny. It's not.
Mia and Leo both invest five hundred dollars a month, for forty years.
Same market. Eight percent a year.
Mia pays a zero point one percent fee. Leo pays one percent.
After forty years, Leo has one point two eight million.
Mia has one point six three million.
That tiny fee took over three hundred fifty thousand dollars. About a fifth of everything.
Check your fees today. Follow for more money math.
